name: After § 3
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 3a. Strongly welcomes the Joint White Paper for European Defence Readiness 20301a, which puts forwards a strong and ambitious road map for enhancing Europe’s security; calls on the Commission and the Member States to swiftly implement the various ambitious elements without delay, as Europe needs to have the ability to deter aggressors and defend itself on all fronts, to take leadership and act rapidly on questions of security, and to produce defence equipment for its own needs; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a JOIN(2025)0120.
